blocks.text: INGLEWOOD, California — Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy III each scored 25 points and the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Los Angeles Clippers 105-104 on Friday night in their NBA Cup group finale. Both teams were 1-3 in group play. Williamson was 11 of 15 from the field and had seven rebounds and five assists. Murphy was 9 of 16 and had six steals.
